description: This file contains CSS styles, including variables for theme management and responsive design rules for the frontend of a Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application style that provides central alignment and theme-dependent background and text colors.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styles for the title of the game, including color and font size.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Container for the game layout with flexbox properties.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Style for displaying the game status text.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Styles for the game board layout.

classes.name: board-row
classes.description: Styles for each row in the game board.

classes.name: game-square
classes.description: Styles for each individual square in the Tic Tac Toe grid.

classes.name: game-actions
classes.description: Container for the game action buttons.

classes.name: game-button
classes.description: Styles for the game action buttons.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header of the application, providing layout and color properties.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links in the application.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between themes.
